`fopen("compress.zlib://f.gz")` decompressed while every other caller of the SAME opener —
`file_get_contents`, and through it `file` and `readfile` — got `Failed to open stream`. The
handling sat in `lower_fopen`, above the opener, so only that one spelling reached it.
